package.name: blockpose_core
package.description: ROS-free C++ core of the blockpose concrete-block detector (geometry, proposals, refinement, RGB edge prior). Consumed by concrete_block_detector via find_package(blockpose_core CONFIG REQUIRED). This package.xml exists solely so a plain `colcon build` discovers, builds and installs it in the right order ahead of its ROS consumers -- it is not itself a ROS package (no ament_package(), no message/service generation).
